L5-L9: The card needs source-anchored raw values from the three bound filings. The attempt's isolated venv has no PDF library and installing one needs the network, which is forbidden. The global Miniconda interpreter has PyMuPDF but card rules forbid running cards on the global interpreter. So this extractor implements the subset of PDF needed to read text with the standard library only (re, zlib).

L15-L18: * Type0/Identity-H fonts with a ToUnicode CMap, TrueType/Type1 fonts with WinAnsiEncoding or an explicit ToUnicode CMap, simple one-byte encodings. * Does NOT do: cryptography, linearisation repair, LZW/JPX, CID fonts without ToUnicode, layout analysis beyond (y desc, x asc) line grouping, table detection.
